hero.title: GIANLIVIO IEMOLO
hero.desc: I build web platforms, integrate APIs, and work with data and content. E-commerce, automation, SEO/GEO. Master's degree in semiotics — an analytical approach applied to the structure of code and interfaces. Remote, in Italian, English and Spanish.

stats.desc: ANAC archive 2015-2025 on migrant reception contracts. Three datasets merged and processed in Python, published on osservatorioaccoglienza.org.

items.title: ANAC data pipeline — 18,000 records
items.desc: Ingestion of three public ANAC datasets in Python: monthly downloads, normalisation, two-level filtering with a confidence index. Archive spanning 2015-2025, 18,000 rows, versioned in the repo.

items.title: Parser for 90 ministerial PDFs
items.desc: pdfplumber extraction of the series on unaccompanied foreign minors from ministry reports: 84 monthly reports from 2016 to 2022, plus half-yearly reports up to 2025. Source limitations stated on the methodology page.

items.title: Static site and automation
items.desc: Next.js/TypeScript on Vercel, hand-written CSS with variables, no UI framework. GitHub Actions workflow for the monthly data-update reminder. Technical SEO and structured data. Code and data open source.

items.title: Futura Blog editorial platform
items.desc: Development in Next.js/TypeScript with Supabase: architecture, deployment, continuous iteration on features and UX. Built by two people, from product definition to launch.

items.title: AI agents for the newsroom
items.desc: Writing and tuning the prompts for the agents that generate and review content. Tone-of-voice calibration for each client, human review on every published article.

items.title: SEO/GEO and editorial planning
items.desc: Google Search Console analysis, monthly editorial plans, optimisation for search engines and generative answers. Two active clients: construction and student housing.

items.title: Open2B e-commerce template
items.desc: Full theme development on Open2B/Scriggo: mobile-first structure, dark mode, multi-step checkout, AJAX dynamic filters, product cards with badges, SKU and real-time availability.

items.title: 20+ active integrations
items.desc: Brevo, Feedaty, Kelkoo, Trovaprezzi, Doofinder, Cerved, VIES, DocFinance, Facebook Graph API, Google Identity. Automatic retry, rate limiting, intelligent fallback, JSON logs for every webhook.

items.title: Open2B ↔ Brevo synchronisation
items.desc: Two-way flow between the management system and the email platform: 58,000 contacts with automatic B2B/B2C segmentation and 23,550 products pushed to Brevo eCommerce. Batches of 100 SKUs, real-time webhooks, 429 rate-limit handling.

items.title: European tax validation
items.desc: Unified API Cerved (IT) + VIES (EU) for VAT number verification across 28 countries. Filesystem cache, smart soft-fail, auto-fill of company data at checkout. Hard-blocking on invalid VAT.

items.title: GA4 / GTM tracking and GDPR
items.desc: Full GA4 e-commerce events, Facebook Pixel with url_passthrough, Microsoft UET. Cookiebot consent layer and Consent Mode v2, cookies blocked before consent, audit trail across all active tags.

items.title: Performance optimisation
items.desc: LCP from 12s to 4s on mobile via lazy-loading, preload, deferred JS, forced-reflow elimination. TBT reduced by 40%. Mobile-first CSS refactoring: 15,000 lines reduced to 10,000, centralised utilities.
